### Summary
A cross-bank money laundering ring involving 5 new accounts across BANK_A, BANK_B, and BANK_C operated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-20, utilizing 8 linking transfers totaling amount bands of 5k-8k and 8k-10k. Funds do not return to the start.

### How the Money Moved
Funds flowed across institutions in multi-hop transfers starting on 2026-08-13 from M-96b737a0f242 (BANK_C) to M-4e8082b8e04b (BANK_A), onward to M-070878439b41 and M-6b0d88edbfc0 (BANK_B), and through M-594ba1fc6a97 (BANK_C) in rapid pass-through windows. 

### Evidence by Bank
* **BANK_A:** Account M-4e8082b8e04b exhibited rapid pass-through and amounts just under 10k.
* **BANK_B:** Accounts M-070878439b41 and M-6b0d88edbfc0 showed rapid pass-through and mostly cross-bank activity.
* **BANK_C:** Accounts M-594ba1fc6a97 and M-96b737a0f242 displayed rapid pass-through and mostly cross-bank movement (lead bank).

### Red-Flag Indicators
* Ring spans 3 banks.
* 5 members are new accounts.
* Most transfers sit just under the 10k reporting threshold.
* Several members pass money on within 72 hours (rapid pass-through).

### Confidence
Score: 75 / 100. Reasons: ring spans 3 banks (+25); most transfers sit just under the 10k reporting threshold (+20); 5 members are new accounts (+15); several members pass money on within 72 hours (+15).

### Recommended Action
The compliance officer at each respective bank (BANK_A, BANK_B, and BANK_C) must separately review and approve this joint case file before any suspicious transaction report is formally filed.
